final: WITH counts AS (SELECT r.ordervault, o.orderflow, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY r.ordervault, o.orderflow), shares AS (SELECT ordervault, orderflow, record_count, 1.0 * record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY orderflow) AS share FROM counts), compared AS (SELECT ordervault, orderflow, record_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY orderflow) AS share_difference FROM shares) SELECT ordervault, orderflow, record_count, share, share_difference FROM compared WHERE share_difference > 0 ORDER BY share_difference DESC LIMIT 10
